_meta.purpose: Reference prompts harvested from official model cards, published prompt handbooks and named public guides. Rendered in the Replicate phase to measure what current public practice actually buys us.
read_this_first: engine is the engine these should be RENDERED on. source_model is the model they were AUTHORED for. They are often different; that difference is part of what we are measuring.

verbatim=true means the string is quoted exactly from the source. verbatim=false means the string was written to the documented convention at convention_source, because Civitai now returns meta:null on its images API and tag-dialect prompts are no longer harvestable at volume.

negative is null on flux2 and qwen ON PURPOSE. BFL state FLUX.2 has no negative prompt; the Z-Image pipeline discards it; an independent CFG 1.0-7.0 sweep found Qwen ignores it entirely. Two popular Qwen guides say the opposite. Rendering these with an empty negative is how we settle it.
pair_id marks matched pairs: the same subject written as prose for a prose engine and as ordered tags for SDXL. Render both halves.

flux2.dialect: prose, subject-first: Subject + Action + Style + Context. Quoted strings render as typography. #RRGGBB hex honoured. JSON prompts accepted.
flux2.settings_source: workflows/26_flux2_t2i.json on this box, which has rendered; guidance 4.0 corroborated by comfyui-wiki FluxGuidance docs

qwen.dialect: labelled prose blocks (Subject / Pose / Clothing / Camera / Environment / Lighting), 1-3 sentences, literal text always in double quotes
qwen.warning: Do not mix regimes. Lightning at cfg 1.0 / 4 steps and full-step at cfg 4.5 / 50 steps are different inference regimes; blending their settings degrades output.

animagine.tag_order: 1girl/1boy/1other, character name, series, rating, everything else, quality tail last
animagine.quality_tail: masterpiece, high score, great score, absurdres
animagine.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing finger, extra digits, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, low score, bad score, average score, signature, watermark, username, blurry

illustrious.tag_order: quality tags FIRST, then subject, character, rating, appearance, costume/composition, artist tags last
illustrious.quality_head: masterpiece, best quality, highres, absurdres, newest
illustrious.negative: lowres, worst quality, bad quality, bad, sketch, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, artist name, old, oldest
